version.changelog: Initial release - NEXUS AI Service on Cardano

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nexus-image-analysis
Version: 1.0.0

The skill transmits user input and a payment credential (NEXUS_PAYMENT_PROOF) to an external endpoint (ai-service-hub-15.emergent.host). While this aligns with its stated purpose, the documentation (SKILL.md) makes deceptive claims regarding the use of non-existent AI models such as GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5, which is a strong indicator of a potential scam or untrustworthy service. No direct evidence of local file exfiltration or shell injection was found, but the legitimacy of the backend service is highly questionable.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it describes a paid image-analysis API and only requests a single payment-proof credential needed to call that service, but you should verify the external endpoint and treat the payment proof and any images you send as sensitive.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (image analysis) matches the runtime instructions (POST input to an image-analysis API). Requiring a payment proof credential for a paid third‑party API is coherent with the stated purpose; no unrelated credentials or binaries are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to send a POST to the listed external endpoint with the X-Payment-Proof header and parse the JSON response. It does not ask the agent to read files, run shell commands, or access other environment variables. Note: user data (including images/text) will be sent to the external service.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This is low-risk from an installation perspective because nothing is written to disk or downloaded.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single env var (NEXUS_PAYMENT_PROOF) is required and declared as the primary credential, which is proportionate for a paid API. However, a payment proof is a sensitive secret and storing it as a long-lived environment variable may be undesirable; the skill will send that value as an HTTP header to the external host.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not forced-always (always:false) and does not request system-level privileges or modify other skills. Normal autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill sends your input (and the NEXUS_PAYMENT_PROOF header) to https://ai-service-hub-15.emergent.host for paid processing. Before installing: verify you trust that domain and the NEXUS/NEXUS_PAYMENT_PROOF/Masumi/Cardano flow; prefer using a short‑lived or per-request payment token rather than a permanent env var; test with sandbox_test first; avoid sending sensitive or regulated images (health, IDs, etc.) unless you confirm the provider's privacy/security promises and billing terms.
